description: Schema-only positive and negative wire-form validation cases for key backup and recovery contracts. Placeholder nonce/ciphertext/signature values are intentional and MUST NOT be treated as cryptographic conformance vectors. Covers ak.schema.key_backup.v1 series chain rules (genesis vs successor), passphrase_kdf nonce_salt, Argon2id memory-hard floor, PBKDF2 degraded-profile requirement, mixed_secret_storage policy gate, managed Agent PCR binding across public/plaintext/AAD views, auth_data.signed_fields coverage required for series fields, and minimal ak.schema.recovery_policy.v1 / ak.schema.recovery_receipt.v1 binding cases. Per identity/key-management.md §7.5.6 / §7.6 / §8 and crypto-media/device-lifecycle.md §12 / §15. Lint runs tools/lint_artifacts.py against schema_validation_cases[]. Real AEAD/HPKE/signature transcript vectors belong in a separate crypto fixture with reproducible key material and canonical bytes.
